name: 徐曉萱
objective:
This course enables students to understand the fundamental concepts in materials science, modern theory of solids, and semiconductor physics. It will also cover the introduction of electronic devices and semiconductor processing currently used in the semiconductor industry. Additionally, students will learn the basic concepts of solar cells, including the working principles, material selection, and applications.
(Course taught in English)
課程進度(1-16週):
1. Introduction 
2. Elementary Materials Science Concepts 
3. Electrical  Conduction in Solids 
4. Elementary Quantum Physics
5. Fundamentals of Semiconductor 
6. Semiconductor Devices (LED and Solar Cell) 
7. Materials processing and fabrication
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          During Weeks 17–18, a total of 6 hours will be allocated for flexible learning. The course will be conducted through asynchronous distance learning. Students will engage in independent learning by watching digital video materials or reading the assigned materials.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will demonstrate their understanding of the course materials by completing and submitting the assigned assignments.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Assignment completion and submission will account for 30% of the Class Participation grade.
